coordinates: HKTex load_mesh: composed GLB scene transforms, subtract surface centroid, scale longest extent to 2
near_clip_rule: Existing rasterizer: max(max(norm(ptp(vertices, axis=0)), 1e-12) * 1e-7, 1e-12); no far clipping plane
basis: Existing perspective_camera_basis: right=cross(forward,up_hint), up=cross(right,forward); up_hint Y except abs(dot(forward,Y))>0.99 then Z
pixel_sampling: one pixel-center surface sample; no antialiasing, lighting, denoising, sharpening or extra gamma

branding_location_evidence.method: Visually inspected original texture atlas and side previews, mapped 30 closest UV face centroids around atlas pixel (940,455) in 1400x1400 overview to normalized GLB geometry
